critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: <LiveJobs /> placed at JobsPage.jsx line 61 directly above <JobFeeds />, exactly per spec.

LiveJobs.jsx animate-spin is bound to local `loading` state which flips off as soon as the (often cached) API resolves — visually the spin is barely perceptible on cache hits. Consider a min-spin duration of ~300ms for better UX, but not a blocker.
401 console errors observed on /jobs are from an unrelated auth/me endpoint when anonymous; unrelated to live-jobs feature.
Card data-testid uses raw Job Bank numeric ids (e.g. live-job-49479107) — selector ^='live-job-' is robust.
